text:
Maya (Marketplace): Quick sync request — Nebula appliance co-listing on cloud marketplaces. We need anchor private-offer commit terms + joint announce window. Target Q4.
Alex (Partnerships): What are the vendor asks? commit size, discount caps, renewal terms?
Maya (Marketplace): Vendor wants a $300k minimum yearly commit to unlock listed SKU and co-marketing. They want 25-35% off depending on term length. Also asking for a 12mo mandatory renewal auto-opt unless we give 60d opt-out.
Sam - HW Sales: 25-35% is wide. Can we tier: 25% for 12mo, 30% for 18mo, 35% for 24mo + co-sell credit? That helps our ARR predictability.
Jules (Legal): Heads up — 12mo mandatory auto-renew needs careful phrasing. We should avoid automatic renewal without active notice at 90/60/30d windows. Also need termination for convenience and data handling addendum for Marketplace listing.
Alex (Partnerships): Also need SKU mapping and marketplace listing SKU parity. Nebula wants exclusive marketplace SKU for first 90 days. Is that okay?
Maya (Marketplace): Exclusive SKU for 90d is acceptable if we get a delivery SLA and marketing commit. We'll expose a private-offer SKU that maps to our standard PROD SKU. Ops: any infra constraints?
ops-bot: FYI: private-offer SKUs require support plan flag and billing mapping. ETA for mapping work = 5 business days once PO signed.
Sam - HW Sales: For renewals, propose a usage uplift clause: if customer consumption >110% of commit, discount steps down next term by 5pp or we convert to reserved capacity. Keeps unit economics sensible. Thoughts?
Jules (Legal): Usage uplift clause OK but needs clear measurement window and audit rights. Add a clause: usage measured by Redwood billing system, disputes resolved via 30d remediation period.
Maya (Marketplace): Great. Next steps: I'll draft an offer term sheet with tiers and renewal language. Can someone own the co-marketing ask (creative + budget) and confirm exclusive SKU acceptance? Propose 2pm sync today.
Alex (Partnerships): I can own co-marketing and run the acceptance thread with Nebula.
Sam - HW Sales: I'll confirm SLA metrics and delivery timeline.
Jules (Legal): I'll sketch the renewal + audit language and drop into the doc.
Maya (Marketplace): Awesome — linking a quick template below for the offer that I'll fill out in the drive after the sync:
```
SKU: NEB-APPL-1-PRV
Commit options: $300k/yr (12mo) @25% | $450k/18mo @30% | $600k/24mo @35%
Renewal: auto-renew w/ 60d notice; customer may opt-out with written notice. Usage uplift: >110% triggers review and potential contract conversion.
Co-marketing: Nebula funds $50k co-marketing; Redwood provides listing + 2 joint webinars.
Exclusivity: 90d exclusive SKU listing in marketplace subject to delivery SLA and marketing activation.
```
Maya (Marketplace): If nobody objects, I'll create the doc and invite Nebula + legal. Ping me if you want to join the 2pm sync. :party-parrot:
Alex (Partnerships): +1, joining.
Sam - HW Sales: On it.
Jules (Legal): Joining too.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled at 14:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent.
